dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software); GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect used in the ORCA project. Program ORCBM501 creates receipt electronic billing data (CSV format, RECEDEN) without claim management, using tbl_receden_tmp. Copied from ORCBM500 in 2017.
evidence: COPY directives with .INC copybooks (CPSK2005.INC, CPRECEDEN.INC, CPBTPARA.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC, COMMON-SPA)
SELECT ... ASSIGN ... ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
JMA Open Source License copyright header
CPTEMPFL.INC REPLACING pattern typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト電算) billing data file creation for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Generates CSV-format electronic claim data (RECEDEN) without claim management processing.
purpose.summary: ORCBM501 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates electronic receipt billing data files (CSV/fixed-format, RECEDEN) for submission to health insurers. It reads receipt data, formats it into structured records, and writes output files along with an error file. It is a variant of ORCBM500 that operates without claim management (ÀÁµá´ÉÍý¤Ê¤·).

notable_features: 27 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (.INC files)
Large table: OCCURS 10000 with PIC X(2500) records
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for output
REPLACING clause in COPY for parameterized file names
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
grpsys group prefix on COPY line (ORCA-specific pattern)
Record size 2500 bytes for receipt data
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese, appearing as mojibake. This is standard for ORCA COBOL sources. Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is 85KB/1959 lines. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software maintained over many years (2003-2017) by NACL developers for JMA.
